_comment: Asset-type catalog for content-asset-creator. The AGENT authors HTML to these structures + the brand tokens; render_asset.mjs exports PNG/PDF. Each type lists the section blocks the content_data model may carry.

report.pages: 2-3 (multi-page; lead with the biggest stat, one takeaway per section)
report.notes: Industry report / lead magnet. Add Open Graph meta for LinkedIn/X previews. Export PNG per page + assembled PDF.

landing-page.notes: Self-contained marketing page asset. Full-page PNG; PDF optional.

comparison.notes: Our product vs competitor sheet. Keep the table scannable; bold the winning cells.

one-pager.notes: Single downloadable one-pager. 1080px wide reads well on social + print.

section_blocks.comparison-table: rows of features x columns of options; bold winning cells
section_blocks.chart: a simple bar/line block (author as styled HTML/SVG)
section_blocks.narrative: body copy, one key takeaway per section
